title: Critical mixing in the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model
main_claim: At beta=1 in zero-field Gaussian SK, with probability tending to one over the disorder: worst-start heat-bath mixing time is n^{2/3+o(1)} with every site at rate one, and n^{5/3+o(1)} attempted updates. The relaxation time R_J and the classical log-Sobolev inverse constant C_LS,J are both n^{2/3+o(1)}. The upper bounds are new and are proved two independent ways: an isotropic-observation support profile and a spectral-cap log-Sobolev inequality. The lower bounds come from the companion critical paper's linear-observable theorem.
coverage:
Checked line by line:
(1) Sec. dynamics.
 - Support-profile-to-mixing lemma: Markov truncation at V/4 for V>=8, log(V/4)>=log(V)/3, the ODE for z=log(V/4), the discrete step using P^2<=P, the Poincaré inequality from the median split, the TV constants and the point-mass bound mu_min >= exp(-(3+log2)n).
 - LSI route: DSC hypercontractivity normalization (4t/C_LS with D equal to the generator's Dirichlet form), the L^p norm of a point density <= e, the discrete L2 spectral comparison, and the expansion giving 2Var <= C_LS D.
 - Eigenfunction TV lower bound, and the C_EP sandwich R/2 <= C_EP <= C_LS/4.
(2) Profile route: removal of the bounded-test restriction (dyadic norm bounds 1/4..1 checked exactly, discarded mass <= S/50, final constant 49/200), the initial-entropy bounds h <= H_0 <= 2h+log100, the order-n contradiction C sqrt(n) n^{1/3}, and the Gronwall step e(b) <= 2 b^theta a^{1-theta}.
(3) Cap route:
 - Layer/capacity lemma: K-layer pigeonhole T_{i+1}>=S_i^2, dyadic entropy <= 48S, Rothaus entropy shift.
 - Observation identities, including tilt e^L and the conditional-entropy tail.
 - Jump-retention bound C k_1(1+(L/k_1)^{1/3}).
 - Product-endpoint exponent bookkeeping in both small-entropy branches, and the large-entropy stopped-path contradiction (cn vs O(n^{5/6})).
 - Radial regeneration: verified with sympy that Tr T = b n(p-c) and that Tr T^2 matches (cap:trace-difference-square), with b=4/(3pi) from the edge density. The three denominator pieces x/d*, 1-x^2, 2(1-x)^2 check out with the N=x^{-2} prefactor. The deficit formula has minimum ~0.29 > 0.26 and ~1/3 > 0.31 at x=gamma.
Only spot-checked or read at overview level: the Kac–Rice root counts and orbit/Haar comparisons (profile-roots/matrices/orbits/local/amplification), the bottom-range replica expansion, the static cube–sphere comparisons, the Haar compression and initialization of the curvature induction, and the planted-to-ordinary disorder transfers. These make up most of the 14k-line paper and were not independently verified.
sibling_notes: Family 227 siblings (Cutoff-throughout-high-temp, Functional-universality, Universality-of-critical-quench) all report no_gap_found. This paper imports from AcceptedCritical only Thm 1.2/1.3 (the realized-start and linear lower bounds), which is used just for the lower exponents. From AcceptedGap it uses only deterministic tools (Prop 7.2/7.3, Lemmas 5.6/5.7/8.1) whose hypotheses are re-verified at j=1, plus a fixed-beta<1 estimate in the cap initialization. No circular use of a critical upper bound from a companion was found.
